product_overview: Nexora Business Suite is a multi-tenant business management platform for small to medium enterprises. It helps teams manage products, orders, customers, finance, reporting, users, and audit history from one workspace.
core_goals: Sign in to an organization workspace and access the correct tenant-specific data
Monitor key business metrics from the dashboard
Manage the product catalog and inventory levels
Create and track customer orders through their lifecycle
Maintain customer records for sales and operations
Create and manage invoices and expense records
Review financial transactions, receivables, and ledger activity
Generate reports for business performance analysis
Manage team members and assign roles
Review audit history of user and system actions

features.name: User Authentication
features.description: Users sign in with workspace credentials and can use demo autofill helpers for faster access.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Use demo credentials autofill -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the organization workspace
Navigate to /login -> Enter email address -> Enter password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See the organization workspace
Navigate to /login -> Submit the sign-in form with empty or invalid credentials -> See validation errors

features.name: Organization Dashboard
features.description: Users view a tenant-specific workspace home page with KPI summaries and navigation shortcuts to other modules.
user_flows: Navigate to /[orgSlug] -> View monthly revenue, active orders, total customers, and pending invoices -> Open a quick navigation tile -> Arrive in the selected module
Navigate to /[orgSlug] -> View system status and summary metrics -> Sign out -> Return to the sign-in page

features.name: Products Management
features.description: Users search, filter, create, edit, and delete products in the catalog, including stock and pricing details.
user_flows: Navigate to /[orgSlug]/products -> Search products by name or SKU -> Filter products by category or stock status -> View the refined catalog list
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/products -> Open the product creation flow -> Enter name, SKU, price, category, and initial stock -> Submit the product form -> See the new product in the catalog
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/products -> Select an existing product -> Edit product details or remove the product -> See the catalog update
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/products/inventory -> Review current stock levels and reorder indicators -> Adjust inventory stock -> See the updated stock count

features.name: Orders Management
features.description: Users manage sales orders by filtering the list, creating new orders, and advancing order status through the workflow.
user_flows: Navigate to /[orgSlug]/orders -> Filter orders by status -> View the matching order list
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/orders -> Start a new order -> Select a customer -> Add items and quantities -> Submit the order -> See the order in the list
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/orders -> Open an order from the list -> View the order details and line items -> Change the order status -> See the updated workflow state
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/orders/[orderId] -> Review the order breakdown -> Mark the order as processing or complete it -> See the new status

features.name: Customer Directory
features.description: Users maintain a searchable directory of customer profiles and add new customer records.
user_flows: Navigate to /[orgSlug]/customers -> Search customers by name, company, or email -> View the matching customer records
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/customers -> Start adding a customer -> Enter name, email, phone, company, and address -> Save the customer profile -> See the new customer in the directory

features.name: Invoicing & Billing
features.description: Users create invoices, review invoice statuses, and transition invoices through their billing lifecycle.
user_flows: Navigate to /[orgSlug]/finance/invoices -> View invoices with status badges -> Open the invoice creation flow -> Select a customer -> Enter issue date, due date, and line items -> Submit the invoice -> See the invoice in the list
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/finance/invoices -> Select an existing invoice -> Review invoice details and line items -> Send the invoice or mark it as paid -> See the updated invoice status
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/finance/invoices/[invoiceId] -> Review tax calculations and balance details -> Transition the invoice status -> See the revised invoice state

features.name: Expenses Tracking
features.description: Users record business expenses with categories and supporting details, then review the saved expense entry.
user_flows: Navigate to /[orgSlug]/finance/expenses -> Filter expenses by category, date range, or payment method -> View the matching expense records
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/finance/expenses -> Start recording an expense -> Enter payee, amount, category, date, and description -> Save the expense entry -> See the expense in the list
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/finance/expenses/[expenseId] -> Review expense details and receipt information -> Inspect the audit metadata for the expense

features.name: General Ledger & Accounting
features.description: Users inspect the chart of accounts, journal entries, and ledger activity for double-entry bookkeeping.
user_flows: Navigate to /[orgSlug]/finance/ledger -> View the chart of accounts and account balances -> Inspect journal entry transactions
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/finance/ledger -> Filter ledger entries by account or date -> View the narrowed ledger results

features.name: Team Members & RBAC
features.description: Users manage the organization roster, invite teammates, and update role assignments.
user_flows: Navigate to /[orgSlug]/users -> View team members and their roles -> Review the organization roster
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/users -> Start inviting a member -> Enter the member email -> Select a role -> Send the invitation -> See the new roster entry
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/users -> Select a team member -> Change the member role or revoke access -> See the updated permissions

features.name: Audit Trail
features.description: Users search and filter audit events to review captured activity history and record changes.
user_flows: Navigate to /[orgSlug]/audit -> Search audit events by entity or action type -> View matching audit records
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/audit -> Filter audit events by date or user actor -> Review the resulting activity log
Navigate to /[orgSlug]/audit -> Open an audit record -> Review the details of the recorded mutation

features.name: Reports & Analytics
features.description: Users review business performance trends and exportable analytics from the reports dashboard.
user_flows: Navigate to /[orgSlug]/reports -> View revenue trends, sales performance, and summary analytics -> Review the business performance dashboard

routes.description: Public landing page showcasing platform overview and entry points
User authentication page with credentials login and quick demo fill
Multi-tenant dashboard home with KPI metrics, quick links, and system status
Product catalog management with SKU, pricing, inventory stock, and creation modal
Inventory stock adjustments and reorder level monitoring
Sales orders list with status filtering, totals, and creation modal
Order detail view with status workflow transition and line items breakdown
Customer management directory with search, contact information, and creation modal
Finance overview hub linking invoices, expenses, payments, receivables, and ledger
Invoices listing, status badges, payment tracking, and invoice creation form
Detailed invoice view with line items, tax calculations, and status transitions
Expenses management with category categorization, receipt tracking, and recording form
Detailed expense view with audit metadata and receipt info
Payments ledger and incoming/outgoing transaction records
Individual payment transaction details and matched invoices
Accounts receivable aging analysis and overdue payment tracking
Double-entry general ledger with chart of accounts and journal entries
Analytics dashboard with revenue trends, sales performance, and exportable reports
Team member management, RBAC role assignment, and user invitations
System audit trail displaying actor actions, entity changes, and timestamps
